name: 2 Litre Hand Pressure Sprayer
lead: Not every spraying job needs a knapsack on your back. This Made-in-Kenya 2 litre hand pump pressure sprayer is a simple, dependable tool for small jobs around the garden, farm and home. It has a clear tank marked from 500 ml to 1750 ml, a steel pump rod and an adjustable brass nozzle, and it is sold as 1 sprayer.
features: 2 litre tank with clear sides, so you can see the level at a glance
Measuring marks from 500 ml to 1750 ml for mixing small volumes
Steel pump rod built for repeated pumping
Adjustable brass nozzle to change the spray pattern for the job
Compact and light enough to carry in one hand
Made in Kenya
Sold as 1 sprayer and delivered to all 47 counties
specs: Tank: 2 litres, clear, marked from 500 ml to 1750 ml
helps: The sprayer suits garden pests, foliar feeds, disinfectants and household pest control. Its small size makes it handy for kitchen gardens, flower beds, nurseries, greenhouse corners, small poultry or livestock houses and spot treatments where a large knapsack sprayer would be too much. A small tank also lets you mix only what the job needs.
use: Fill the tank to the level you need, using the marks on the side, and add your product as directed on its label. Do not fill above the top mark, because the tank needs air space to build pressure. Close the cap firmly, pump the handle until you feel resistance, then spray evenly, moving steadily so that every surface is covered. Pump again when the spray weakens.
before: Read the label of the product you plan to spray, and mix only the volume you need
Check that the cap closes firmly and the nozzle is clear
Where possible, use a separate sprayer for herbicides to avoid contaminating other crops
safety: Wear gloves, a mask and eye protection when spraying chemicals, and release the pressure before opening the cap. Never eat, drink or smoke while spraying. Keep the sprayer and any chemical away from children.
storage: Rinse the tank and nozzle with clean water after every use so that residue does not block the nozzle, then store the sprayer clean and dry, out of direct sun and away from children.
faq: What size is the tank?
It holds 2 litres. The clear tank is marked from 500 ml to 1750 ml, so you can see the level and mix small volumes.
What can I spray with it?
Garden pests, foliar feeds, disinfectants and household pest control products, each as its own label directs.
Why should I not fill it to the top?
The tank needs air space to build pressure, so fill it only to the top mark.
How do I keep the nozzle from blocking?
Rinse the tank and nozzle with clean water after every use so that residue does not dry inside.

Remove people, pets, food, feed and animals from the space you will fog

name: Jacto HD 550 Knapsack Sprayer
lead: A sprayer is one of the most used tools on a farm, and a weak one wastes product and time. The Jacto HD 550 is a heavy-duty manual knapsack sprayer with a 20 litre tank. It has a piston pump, an internal agitator, a reinforced hose and an adjustable nozzle for spraying pesticides, herbicides and foliar fertilizers on farms and gardens, and for pest control.
features: Heavy-duty manual knapsack sprayer
20 litre tank
Piston pump
Internal agitator
Reinforced hose
Adjustable nozzle
For pesticides, herbicides and foliar fertilizers
For farms, gardens and pest control
helps: A strong, well-built sprayer gives more even coverage, lasts through many seasons and wastes less product. The Jacto HD 550 is designed for repeated, regular use by commercial growers, farm workers and spraying contractors as well as home gardeners. The piston pump builds pressure with each stroke of the lever, which gives a steady spray. The internal agitator stirs the mixture as you pump, which helps keep products that settle, such as suspensions and powders, evenly mixed. The reinforced hose is made to take pressure and daily handling, and the adjustable nozzle changes the spray pattern from fine coverage on leaves to a more directed spray.
use: Fill the tank to the level you need, add the product at the rate on its label, close the lid and pump to build pressure. Spray evenly and walk at a steady pace. Calibrate your sprayer so that you know how much it delivers over a given area, and use that figure to work out how much product goes into each tank. It sprays pesticides, herbicides and foliar fertilizers on crops, orchards, flower farms and gardens, and it is used for pest control around homes, stores and compounds.
before: Where possible, use a separate sprayer for herbicides to avoid contamination
Check the seals and the hose for leaks
Clean the nozzle and the filter
safety: Wear gloves, a mask, goggles and protective clothing when spraying, and follow the product label. Do not spray in windy weather. Do not eat, drink or smoke while spraying. Release the pressure before opening the lid, and keep the sprayer away from children.
storage: Rinse the tank, hose and nozzle with clean water after every use, clean the nozzle and filter regularly, and store the sprayer clean and dry, away from direct sun and children.
faq: Is the Jacto HD 550 manual or motorised?
It is a manual knapsack sprayer with a piston pump, so it is pumped by hand with the lever.
What does the internal agitator do?
It stirs the mixture inside the tank as you pump, which helps keep products that settle, such as suspensions and powders, evenly mixed.
Can I use it for herbicides and pesticides?
Yes. It is made for pesticides, herbicides and foliar fertilizers. Where possible, keep a separate sprayer for herbicides to avoid contamination.

name: Greenberg Bronze Knapsack Sprayer
lead: A sprayer that leaks, clogs or tires your back costs you time and wastes chemical. The Greenberg Bronze Knapsack Sprayer is a heavy-duty manual sprayer in a 16 litre size, made for applying agrochemicals, foliar fertilizers and public health control products across farm fields and horticultural plots. It is built from rugged, high-grade plastic to cope with daily agricultural use, and it is sold as 1 sprayer.
features: 16 litre tank for fewer refill trips
Ergonomic tank shape that sits naturally against the operator's back
Robust pumping mechanism that gives consistent operating pressure
Even, fine spray mist that reaches upper and lower leaf surfaces
Adjustable nozzles: switch between a concentrated jet and a broad cone pattern
Wide filling mouth with a built-in strainer basket to help prevent nozzle clogging
Accessible seals and durable shut-off valves for simple maintenance
Brand: GreenBerg
helps: Use it for crop protection sprays, foliar feeding, weed control and pest control jobs on small and medium farms, kitchen gardens, greenhouses and nurseries. The adjustable nozzle lets you use a tight jet to reach a target and a wider cone for covering foliage, so one sprayer handles several tasks. Spraying sessions can be long, so the back-contoured tank and the steady pumping action are designed to reduce fatigue. Even coverage is what makes a product work properly, because missed patches become the place where pests and weeds return.
use: Fill through the wide filling mouth, where the built-in strainer basket helps prevent nozzle clogging, add the product as its label directs, close the tank and pump to a steady pressure. Switch between the concentrated jet and the broad cone pattern with the adjustable nozzle, depending on whether you are aiming at a target or covering foliage. Keep a regular pace so that every row is covered evenly.
before: Check the seals and the strainer basket, and clean the strainer if it clogs
If you can, keep one sprayer for herbicides and another for insecticides and fungicides, so that herbicide residue never reaches your crop
Read the chemical label for the dose and re-entry times
safety: Always wear overalls, boots, gloves and a face mask when spraying agricultural chemicals. Follow the chemical label for dose and re-entry times. Keep the sprayer and all chemicals out of reach of children.
storage: Rinse the tank thoroughly with clean water after every use, then spray clean water through the hose and nozzle so that no residue dries inside. Store the sprayer upside down in a shaded, dry place, away from direct sunlight and extreme temperatures.

Can I use it for fertilizer?
Yes. It is designed for agrochemicals, foliar fertilizers and public health control products. Rinse well between products.

The wide filling mouth has a built-in strainer basket that helps prevent the nozzle from clogging.
